reviews.title: Too late to matter
reviews.text: Although this app gives the information of earthquakes that have happened, the alerts I receive are way too late to take action. I regularly receive an alert about 30 minutes after an earthquake that would have reached me within a minute to a minute and a half of when it happened. If you want information about earthquakes, this app has it… If you want to be alerted to an oncoming earthquake so that you can possibly get to a safe location, this app is not for you.

reviews.title: Not Recommened-Virus Ads
reviews.text: I would not recommend this app. I’ve had this for several years and thought it was moderately helpful. Recently, I wanted to get more data on a recent event. When I went to go into the event, it loaded and ad, and the ad was similar to the recommended action, and I clicked on that instead of the actual app button. I am now getting several virus messages from this app. I have removed this and will not use this app again.
